description: Header file declaring functions and constants for Wi-Fi WPA Supplicant plugin, including initialization, cleanup, daemon control, and configuration functions.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_init
methods.description: Initializes the WPA Supplicant plugin with a given endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources for the WPA Supplicant plugin.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_reloadDaemon
methods.description: Reloads or restarts the WPA Supplicant daemon.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_writeConfig
methods.description: Writes configuration for the WPA Supplicant.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the WPA Supplicant daemon is running.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_isAlive
methods.description: Checks if the WPA Supplicant process is alive.
